# Perxona Connect Kit

> Add a talking 3D AI avatar to any web app. The Perxona Connect API (REST) plus the `<sv-presenter>` avatar Web Component (Presenter SDK): pick an avatar, scene and voice, call `present(text)`, and it speaks with lip-sync and emotion. Samples and tools live in this repo; the full handbook is at https://connect.perxona.ai.

Key facts for agents:

- The Presenter SDK is loaded once as a module script from a `PRESENTER_URL` your server supplies (not a secret) and registers the `<sv-presenter>` custom element. There is no bundled npm SDK yet; `@perxona/presenter-types` on npm provides TypeScript types only.
- Two keys: a **secret** Connect API key (server side only) and a **publishable** key (browser). Create both in the Perxona Console under the organization management page, Integration, Connect API keys.
- Fastest path: `git clone` this repo, `cd samples/express`, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, `npm install`, `npm run dev`, open http://localhost:8083.
- Usage is metered in organization credits (`GET /credit`); when they run out, metered calls fail with HTTP 400 and `code: 1003`.

## Samples and tools

- [Express sample README](https://github.com/XRSPACE-Inc/perxona-connect-kit/blob/main/samples/express/README.md): setup, auth model, backend adapter routes, troubleshooting
- [Agent notes for the Express sample](https://github.com/XRSPACE-Inc/perxona-connect-kit/blob/main/samples/express/AGENTS.md): how to scaffold a new demo from the existing ones
- [InterviewCoach demo](https://github.com/XRSPACE-Inc/perxona-connect-kit/blob/main/samples/express/public/demos/interview/README.md): a practice app where the avatar is the product
- [VRM uploader](https://github.com/XRSPACE-Inc/perxona-connect-kit/blob/main/tools/vrm-uploader/README.md): check and upload your own .vrm avatar
